        for(int i = 0; i < s.length; i++) {
            if(s[i] == 'X') {
                s[i] = x;
            }
        }
        if(s[0] == '0') {
            return 0;
        }
        int ans = 1;
        boolean first = true;
        for(int i = 0; i < s.length; i++) {
            if(s[i] == '_') {
                ans *= i == 0 ? 9 : 10;
            } else if(s[i] == 'X' && first) {
                ans *= i == 0 ? 9 : 10;
                first = false;
            }
        }
        return ans;
    }
    
    private static boolean canReplace(char[] s, char a, char b) {
        int n = s.length;
        if(n >= 2) {
            if(s[n-2] >= '0' && s[n-2] <= '9' && s[n-2] != a) {
                return false;
            }
            if(s[n-1] >= '0' && s[n-1] <= '9' && s[n-1] != b) {
                return false;
            }
            if(s[n-2] == 'X' && s[n-1] == 'X' && a != b) {
                return false;
            }
        }
        return true;
    }
    
    public static void main(String[] args) throws IOException{
        BufferedReader f = new BufferedReader(new InputStreamReader(System.in));
        PrintWriter out = new PrintWriter(new BufferedWriter(new OutputStreamWriter(System.out)));
        char[] s = f.readLine().toCharArray();
        
        if(s.length < 2) {
            out.println(s[0] == '0' || s[0] == '_' || s[0] == 'X' ? 1 : 0);
        } else {
            int ans = 0;
            char[][] replacements = {{'0','0'}, {'2','5'}, {'5','0'}, {'7','5'}};
            
            for(char[] pair : replacements) {
                if(canReplace(s, pair[0], pair[1])) {
                    char[] t = s.clone();
                    t[t.length-2] = pair[0];
                    t[t.length-1] = pair[1];
                    if(s[s.length-2] == 'X') {
                        ans += solve(t, t[t.length-2]);
                    } else if(s[s.length-1] == 'X') {
                        ans += solve(t, t[t.length-1]);
                    } else {
                        ans += solve(t, 'X');
                    }
                }
            }
            out.println(ans);
        }
        f.close();
        out.close();
    }
}
